messages:
Lina: Quick q — we've got a config-only tweak to the runtime batching window (no API/CLI changes). Do we bump patch or minor?
Matt: Patch. If there's no public contract change, it's a patch. Keep the semver semantic.
Zoe: Confirmed no model signatures or API flags changed — purely internal perf tuning.
Lina: Sweet. For tagging convention should we use `chore:` or `fix:` in the tag/message?
Matt: Use `chore(runtime):` for infra/config stuff. Example tag command: 
Matt: ```
git tag -a v1.12.3 -m "chore(runtime): adjust batching window to reduce tail latency (no API change)"
git push origin v1.12.3
```
Matt: And PR body should have a one-line release note like: `- chore(runtime): reduce tail latency by adjusting batch window (no behavioral change)`
Lina: Good — also planning to deploy during the 22:00 UTC change window tomorrow. deploy-bot will pick it up if we add `#release` to PR?
Matt: yup, `#release` + semver tag in the merge commit triggers the bot pipeline.
deploy-bot: Release v1.12.3 scheduled for 2024-11-12 22:00 UTC :calendar: (canary 10% for 10m)
Ava: What's our rollback criteria? Can we auto-rollback on a small error bump?
Zoe: Proposed: if 5m error rate increases by >0.5% or p99 latency increases by >20% in canary, auto rollback. We've got tracing hooks and canary alarms wired.
Matt: Agree. Add the thresholds to PR checklist so deploy-bot annotations include them.
Lina: On pinning: this change doesn't touch deps or lockfiles, so no pin required. We'll push to stable channel after successful canary.
Ava: I'll monitor during rollout and have oncall handover ready.
Lina: Merging PR now, adding `#release` and release note.
deploy-bot: PR merged by Lina. Deploy queued for 2024-11-12 22:00 UTC. :shipit:
Matt: Reminder — use `chore(runtime):` prefix in CHANGELOG so it's clear for audit.
Lina: Done. Tagging and changelog entry added. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ava: Watching the rollout window. Ping me if anything goes sideways.
Zoe: If we need a hotfix later, we follow the same patch bump flow; only escalate to minor if customer-facing behavior changes. :eyes:
Matt: One more nit — keep tag messages in present tense and include parenthesis `(no API change)` when it's safe to skip minor bump. Helps reviewers.
Lina: Noted. Closing thread.
